item_short_desc: The Marksman 3/8" Steel Hunting Shot delivers precision and durability for superior slingshot performance. Crafted from high-quality steel and polished for a smooth finish, these shots ensure accuracy with every use. Compatible with all slingshots, this pack of 75 steel shots is perfect for hunting, target practice, or outdoor adventures.
